## Implementation Complete

**Change:** `apply-coupon-to-order` (schema: spec-driven)
**Progress:** 12/12 tasks complete ✓
**Verification:** `npm run build` clean, `npm test` 36/36 passing (10 pre-existing + new)

### What was built

`POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` — applies one coupon to a pending order.

| Layer | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/routes/orders.ts` | Registered the route; parses id, passes `couponCode` through |
| `src/services/orderService.ts` | `applyCoupon(id, rawCode)` — normalization, precedence-ordered validation, atomic write, reload |
| `src/services/discount.ts` | Pure `computeDiscount` (FIXED / PERCENT floor / cap / clamp) |
| `src/repositories/orderRepository.ts` | `applyCoupon(...)` column update + `transaction<T>` (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) |
| `src/repositories/couponRepository.ts` | `insertRedemption(...)`, `incrementUsedCount(...)` |
| `src/app.ts` | Injects `CouponRepository` into `OrderService` |

All rules REQ-01…REQ-14 are covered, including error precedence (1–10), the 400/404/409 status mapping, inclusive `validFrom` / exclusive `validUntil` via the injected `Clock`, and the three-table transactional write with rollback-reported-by-tests. New tests in `tests/applyCoupon.test.ts` (26) and `tests/discount.test.ts` (5) cover AC-01…AC-10 plus every error code and precedence pair.

### Constraints honored
- `TASK.md` untouched; `tests/orders.test.ts` untouched; no schema changes; no new dependencies.
- Layering preserved: routes parse, rules in services, all SQL in repositories.

### OpenSpec artifacts
`openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/` — `proposal.md`, `specs/order-coupons/spec.md` (15 requirements, validates `--strict`), `design.md`, `tasks.md` — planning marked 4/4 complete.

The one remaining workflow follow-up is archiving the change (`/opsx:archive`), which I've left for after review.
